basics.name: Punit Mishra
basics.title: Senior Machine Learning Expert & AI Tech Lead
basics.summary: Applied AI engineer and technical leader with 14+ years taking machine learning from prototype to dependable production at enterprise scale. Not only an architect — I implement, deploy, and own systems end to end, from agent runtimes and LLM inference pipelines through GPU deployment on custom H100 clusters and production scaling. As Senior ML Expert and AI Tech Lead in SAP CX Data & AI, I lead a team of thirteen and personally build the agent orchestration, memory, multi-model serving, and multi-tenant infrastructure beneath our LLM products.

experience.position: Senior Machine Learning Expert & AI Tech Lead — CX Data & AI
experience.summary: Lead and personally build the agent orchestration, LLM serving, and multi-tenant infrastructure beneath SAP CX's LLM products.
highlights: Built and own a domain-agnostic conversational agent platform — a memory-managed runtime with multi-tenant LangGraph orchestration reusable across business domains, with performance-critical paths in Rust
Authored natural-language-to-SQL over S/4HANA, turning business questions into validated queries — shipping within SAP's 2026 public and private cloud releases
Introduced Ray and built LLM serving on custom bare-metal H100 GPU clusters; multi-model serving (self-hosted plus Claude, Qwen, Granite-class) on Kubernetes with automated evaluation harnesses
Delivered visual and textual LLM agents across SAP's CX & Commerce AI Toolkit (PyTorch on Kubernetes); visual-attribute prediction on OpenAI / CLIP embeddings backed by vector search and RAG
Designed multi-tenant ML on Kubeflow & Knative (Azure AKS) across SAP CX cloud (C4C, CPQ, CDC), with feature stores (Feathr, Feast)
Re-architected vision — attribute extraction, object detection, visual search — into first-class gRPC agent services via an agent gateway and MCP-based service hub

Lead a team of thirteen; own AI ethics & compliance; SAP Security Expert; set the group's SDLC and engineering standards, and serve as forward-deployed engineer on the platform's first production enterprise customer

experience.position: Senior Software Engineer — Thunderbridge AI / SAP Sales Cloud
experience.summary: Acquired by SAP for $2.4B. Built the Thunderbridge AI ML platform and the CI/CD backbone; earlier, senior automation engineering.
highlights: Designed and built the Thunderbridge AI backend in Python on Dataiku, with multi-tenancy running every customer workload for SAP Sales Cloud optimization
Ported the full Dataiku ML stack to GKE on-prem (Google Anthos) with Istio; built the CI/CD backbone (Jenkins on Kubernetes, Kaniko, Artifactory) plus automated merges (Bulldozer / Policy-Bot)
Engineered multi-partition data resiliency for ML across Oracle, Vertica, SAP HANA, and HDFS (Spark); shipped inference services for CPQ on Dataiku's API node

Integrated SAP security scans (Coverity, Black Duck, Fortify) into Jenkins per commit; earlier, as Senior Automation Engineer, built TDD/Scala ETL validation and Selenium/Java + Node.js UI test frameworks over a self-maintaining Selenium Grid

experience.summary: Automation and test engineering for JPMorgan Chase.
highlights: Built a reporting and data-validation automation framework for JPMorgan Chase
Automated VM creation/configuration via a WCF SOAP service (IIS); parallelized and scheduled test execution across cloud machines with varied OS/browser configs
Developed reusable Selenium / Java test APIs (JUnit, TestNG) adopted across the firm
Built an online teaching-evaluation system for the Law School on a PHP / Oracle 10g backend, integrated with CalNet (Berkeley authentication) for end-of-course student evaluations
Built user-to-user interaction features on the Django backend and an internal analytics tool visualizing user data (logins, time on site) used by the sales team
Automated testing with Selenium IDE and tracked defects; worked with the founding team on wireframes and AWS server configuration

projects.name: CoViber
projects.description: Local-first memory for LLMs over the Model Context Protocol. Maintains a continuously-updated work graph, triage queue, and local semantic memory — no cloud egress.

projects.name: Vaultic
projects.description: Local-first, encrypted password manager in Rust with FIDO2/YubiKey support. One on-disk format shared by CLI, TUI, daemon, GUI, and MCP server. No cloud, no account, no telemetry.

projects.name: Shield AI
